title: EOMasters Toolbox
html:
EOMasters Toolbox

The EOMasters Toolbox brings new features and new scientific tools to SNAP.

One toolbox. Free for everyone.

Since version 2.0, all former Pro features are included in a single, free EOMasters Toolbox. Read about the release.

Python Editor

PyEditor lets you edit and execute Python code directly in SNAP. It lowers the barrier to developing scientific code and is ready when you need it.

Super-resolve Sentinel-2 images

Increase the resolution of 10- and 20-metre bands to 5 metres, with the option to resample 60-metre bands using bicubic interpolation.

Source Code & Feedback

You can install the EOMTBX via SNAP's Plugin Manager.

SNAP is available at the ESA STEP website.

The EOMasters Toolbox is open source and can be found on GitHub. 
If you find issues or have suggestions for improvements and extensions, please use the issue tracker on GitHub.
